rateLimits.note: Free API: fewer than 600 calls a minute (open-meteo.com/en/terms); the API answers X-RateLimit-Limit: 600 with X-RateLimit-Window: 60 (checked 2026-11-10). Counted by IP address and application.
Free API: fewer than 5,000 calls an hour (open-meteo.com/en/terms).
Free API: fewer than 10,000 calls a day (open-meteo.com/en/terms).
Free API: 300,000 calls a month (the pricing table on open-meteo.com/en/terms).

provenance.notes: Terms and licence pages read 2026-11-10. The free API is for non-commercial use only (no subscriptions or advertising); commercial use needs a paid subscription and its API key (customer-*.open-meteo.com hosts, limits per plan, not declared here) or a self-hosted instance. Rate limits are applied 'by IP addresses and application'; one call may cost more than 1 (X-RateLimit-Cost header, heavy requests count as several calls). Data under CC BY 4.0: the licence page asks for a link next to any location Open-Meteo data are displayed, e.g. 'Weather data by Open-Meteo.com'; the underlying models' providers (e.g. Copernicus CAMS for air quality, C3S for reanalysis) carry their own credits on the licence page (https://open-meteo.com/en/license). Misusing applications and IPs may be blocked without notice. No caching or concurrency rule stated.
